slides.body: Title Logo for Moss Book II “Exactly two weeks from today on March 31, players will reunite with Quill in Moss: Book II on PlayStation VR. Moss: Book II builds on all the things players loved in the platinum-selling Moss . Interact with new allies, old friends, and stunningly imagined environments. The stakes are higher than ever, and the player alone will guide Quill to save her world, end the merciless rule of the Arcane, and rise to legend.”
